caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a brownish-red rim that has a dotted decorative pattern and a yellow interior. At the center of the plate is a green vase with two handles, decorated with brown and green shapes. Emerging from the vase is a symmetrical arrangement of stylized floral patterns consisting of brown shapes outlined in green to represent flowers and leaves. There are two large, curved floral stems extending from the sides of the central flower, with smaller green and brown plant motifs on both sides inside the border. The background within the plate features a speckled brown and yellow pattern, and the plate rests on a plain beige background. The artist's name "Charlotte Angus" is printed in small, uppercase letters below the plate drawing on the lower right.
title: Pa. German Plate
